The description oversimplifies and incorrectly generalizes the y-axis range and units.
The description does not state that the figure consists of two line plots showing the relationship between the IWF Fiskalindex and debt ratios for the overall state and central state over time.

The description omits the right y-axis label and units for Schuldenquote (debt ratio) in both diagrams, as well as the specific axis ranges for each diagram (e.g., left diagram IWF Fiskalindex 0 to 2.5, Schuldenquote 60 to 120; right diagram IWF Fiskalindex -5 to 2, Schuldenquote 30 to 70).

The description omits the right diagram entirely, which shows the relationship between the IWF Fiskalindex and the central state debt ratio. It also omits the distinction between the two diagrams (Gesamtstaat vs. Zentralstaat).
The description does not mention the use of triangles as markers for the data points on the lines.
